entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: A Minotaur blacksmith and former planeswalker from Aranzhur, trapped on Ixalan for fourteen years, who lost his spark in the Desparkening.

entities.name: Rumi
entities.description: One of Angrath's two daughters.

entities.name: Jamira
entities.description: Angrath's daughter, invited to attend Strixhaven University.

entities.name: Captain Radcliff
entities.description: Captain of the Devil's Smile, hung from the bowsprit in Angrath's mutiny.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A planeswalker serving the Sun Empire who allies uneasily with Angrath.

entities.name: Saint Elenda
entities.description: The progenitor of the vampires of the Legion of Dusk found in a tomb near Orazca.

entities.name: Teyo
entities.description: A boy Angrath advised not to pity the dead.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who led aerial units and killed Rhonas.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: A leader of aerial units against Rhonas.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: A God-Eternal leading a battalion of Eternals, killed by Gideon.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon whose Immortal Sun trapped planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact Angrath sought on Ixalan to free himself, and that trapped him again on Ravnica.

entities.name: Devil's Smile
entities.description: A notorious ship, renamed Devil's Chains after Angrath's mutiny.

entities.name: Aranzhur
entities.description: Angrath's home plane, conquered by New Phyrexia's Machine Legion.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where Angrath was trapped for fourteen years.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Angrath fought in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane of Strixhaven University.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The city holding the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Bolas's army of Eternals.

entities.name: Machine Legion
entities.description: New Phyrexia's force that conquered and compleated Aranzhur.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The battle on Ravnica in which Angrath fought Bolas's Eternals.

entities.name: Desparkening

events.summary: Trapped by Ixalan's Binding, Angrath joins Captain Radcliff's crew, then leads a nearly bloodless mutiny and renames the ship Devil's Chains.
events.quote: the minotaur led a quick and almost bloodless mutiny that left Radcliff hanging by a gaff hook strapped to the bowsprit.

events.summary: Angrath recognizes Huatli as a planeswalker and offers help leaving the plane; she attacks him, but they later join in the race for Orazca.
events.quote: He recognized Huatli as a fellow planeswalker and offered her assistance in leaving the plane in exchange for help, but at first, she attacked him and fled.

events.summary: Angrath tries to planeswalk to Kaldheim, deduces the blocker is near, and tells Huatli true freedom starts when one realizes one is trapped.
events.quote: He told Huatli that true freedom started when one realized that one was trapped.

events.summary: At a tomb near Orazca they find Saint Elenda; Angrath strikes Huatli and goes on alone, and she sends a Dinosaur to trample him.
events.quote: Huatli reacted by sending a Dinosaur to trample him in the mud.

events.summary: After the Immortal Sun is taken, Angrath vanishes and reunites tearfully with his daughters at the family smithy.
events.quote: He then reunited, teary-eyed, with his daughters at their family's smithy.

events.summary: Lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon, Angrath is trapped by Bolas's Immortal Sun and fights the Eternals, pulling some to his side with controlling magic.
events.quote: he could temporarily pull Eternals to his side during the fight, allowing him to amass a miniature army.

events.summary: Angrath leads ground units against God-Eternal Rhonas while Gideon and Aurelia lead the air, and after Gideon kills Rhonas, Angrath leads a charge that forces Bolas's forces back.
events.quote: After Gideon killed Rhonas, Angrath was able to lead a successful charge against the remaining Eternals

events.summary: Angrath chooses to remain on Ravnica after Chandra disables the Immortal Sun and helps the Gatewatch against Bolas.
events.quote: Angrath was one of the few planeswalkers who chose to remain on Ravnica

events.summary: After the battle Angrath wants to destroy the Immortal Sun but is vetoed, and tells Teyo to pity the loved ones left behind.
events.quote: telling the boy not to pity the dead – for their suffering is over – but rather to pity the loved ones they left behind.

events.summary: Aranzhur is conquered and compleated by New Phyrexia's Machine Legion; Angrath and his daughters defend it, but it is left a shell of frozen iron and ash.
events.quote: the plane was nothing more than a great shell of frozen iron and burning ash.

events.summary: Angrath loses his spark in the Desparkening and travels with his daughters through Omenpaths, agreeing Jamira should attend Strixhaven.
events.quote: Angrath lost his spark in the Desparkening .

relations.quote: had two daughters, Rumi and Jamira .
had two daughters, Rumi and Jamira .

relations.note: He became captain and renamed the ship Devil's Chains.
relations.quote: Now a Captain, Angrath changed the ship's name to Devil's Chains
